# Maison Glint

> Modernist chromeware and architectural tableware crafted in mirror-polished austenitic stainless steel. Designed for the everyday dining ritual, intimate dinner gatherings, and layered table settings.

Maison Glint produces serialized, hand-finished tableware rooted in Swiss and Milanese atelier traditions. Objects feature uninterrupted flat basins, continuous beaded rims, and double-buffed 8K specular mirror polishes (>92% optical reflectivity). Distributed exclusively direct-to-collector through https://www.maisonglint.com with serialized authenticity provenance.

## Core Products & Collections

- [Object 01 — Modernist Chromeware Monograph](https://www.maisonglint.com/product/object-01-the-glint-plate): Single 280 mm exemplar in 1.2 mm AISI 304 stainless steel with double-buffed 8K mirror polish ($58).
- [Object 02 — The Duo Monograph](https://www.maisonglint.com/product/object-02-fluid-coupe-pair): Two matching 280 mm Object 01 pieces for intimate dining and layered charger service ($112).
- [Object 03 — The Host Set Monograph](https://www.maisonglint.com/product/object-03-monolith-serving-knife): Four matching 280 mm Object 01 pieces configured for complete table service across four place settings ($198).
